summary: Decades of Qatar experience and listings across Doha, Lusail and The Pearl are strengths, but conflicting numbers and placeholder reviews appear to cost you buyers.

findings.problem: The header appears to list +974 4491 3333, the call icon appears to use the placeholder tel:+911234567890, and WhatsApp appears to use wa.me/0097450626231.
findings.cost: A buyer who taps the call icon reaches a wrong number.

findings.problem: No visible contact form appears, only a Send a message link to another page.
findings.cost: Buyers must leave the page to enquire and some drop off.

findings.problem: Every testimonial appears to use the same avatar and one reviewer appears as John Doe, with no full names, dates or ratings.
findings.cost: Filler proof makes real clients look fake.

findings.problem: Prices appear as '7,450.000 QAR', the area filter appears as 'Lusail FoxHills Marina', and several cards appear to show 'coming soon...' or 0 bedrooms.
findings.cost: Odd formats and unfinished cards make listings hard to trust.
findings.fix: Clean price format and finished listing cards.

redesign: Real reviews and finished listing cards.
